map.有。北约音标体系中数字通常有特殊读法：3 读作 TREE、5 读作 FIFE、9: Yes. In the NATO system digits usually have special pronunciations: 3 as TREE, 5 as FIFE and 9 as NINER, so that they sound more distinct and are less likely to be confused with other words. This is standard practice on aviation and military radios, and using the same pronunciations when reading numbers in everyday customer service noticeably reduces mishearing.
